# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Setup ------------------------------------------------------------
source(here::here("R", "packages.R"))
source(here::here("R", "summarise.R"))
source(here::here("R", "plots.R"))
# DGP2, correct spec, iid, p = 50, s_instr × decay grid, overlap = 1, 1000 reps
# instruments = PS-only covariates 5..s; s_instr = 0 = negative control
df_iv <- load_sim(here::here("results", "ipw", "instrumentsDGP2.csv.gz"))
summ_iv <- summarise_sim(df_iv) |>
  mutate(s_instr = s - 4,
         sif = factor(s_instr, sort(unique(s_instr))))
```

# INCREASE ACTIVE COVARIATES + DECAY

```{r}
dfm <- filter(summ_iv, decay == 1)   # weak arm; flip to decay == 0.5 for strong tab
iv_extra <- list(facet_wrap(~n, nrow = 1, labeller = lab_n), labs(x = "s_instr"))
# RMSE | |Bias| vs s_instr, faceted by n
for (oc in c("linear", "quad1")) print(panel(dfm, oc, x = sif, extra = iv_extra))
# bal0 vs oracle
for (oc in c("linear", "quad1")) print(
  panel(dfm, oc, x = sif, ests = c("balnet0", "oracle_hajek", "oracle_ht"),
        extra = iv_extra))
#- table -#
perf_table(dfm, cols = c("s_instr", "n"),
           span_lab = \(x) paste0("s_instr = ", x), span_desc = FALSE,
           group = "outcome", title = "Instruments, iid, decay = 1 (c = 1)")
#- MSE decomp -#
for (oc in c("linear", "quad1")) print(
  decomp_plot(filter(dfm, outcome == oc), x = s_instr, cols = n, xlab = "s_instr",
              x_scale = scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 4, 16)),
              title = paste("MSE Decomposition (%) \u2014", oc_labs[oc])))
#- extreme estimates -#
extreme_heat(dfm, "glmnetcv_hajek", x = s_instr, xlab = "s_instr", x_desc = FALSE)
```
